identity.name: MEGADOCK CPU/GPU timing-only runtime calibration on four PINDER 2024-02 apo cases (blind-02 m5 run6, science step s04)
identity.scope: Bounded timing-only calibration (brief section 'Calibration request (science step s04)'); operator selects --stop-after-reproduce. Not the seed's full three-configuration study. No native reference access, no DockQ, no cross-arm comparison, no acceleration/affordability/quality verdict.
identity.software: MEGADOCK (akiyamalab/MEGADOCK) commit 9575280c875732553266e26adc607dd892b02616; CPU binary megadock, GPU binary megadock-gpu, decoygen
identity.dataset: PINDER release 2024-02, apo pairings at unit-manifest indices 3, 5, 9, 15

arms.gpu_dense: megadock-gpu ... -D (6 deg, 54000 rotations; documented in MEGADOCK doc/README.md line 72)

outcome_definition.primary: Per job production wall W (time.monotonic, parent Python): from immediately before docking process creation to after all 50 model PDBs are written, closed and validated.
secondary: D: docking process wall (creation to exit)
P: MEGADOCK printed 'Elapsed time' seconds parsed from log
R: reconstruction wall (first decoygen start to last model written)
status: complete | failed | invalid_output | timeout (per-job timeout 600 s, timeout records lower_bound_s)
outcome_definition.derived_later_by_scientific_step: M[c,a] = max over blocks 1-3 of W[c,a] + E[c]; rho[c] = M[c,gpu_dense]/max(M[c,cpu_standard], M[c,gpu_standard]); tiers per brief. Not computed by the harness.

cuda_samples_headers.evidence: Not checked in this pass; build-only header dependency (NVIDIA/cuda-samples v12.8).

licences.owner_statements: Owner approved use of the unverified FroDock mirror (2026-10-31); this concerns FroDock, which is not used in this calibration. No owner licence statement covers MEGADOCK or PINDER data.

evidence: brief.md lines 349-383: historical run2 setup built and ran both megadock and megadock-gpu on this box type; run4 found nvcc 12.8 at /usr/bin/nvcc, headers /usr/include, libraries /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu.
Build needs g++, FFTW3 single precision (libfftw3f), CUDA nvcc/cudart/cufft, and NVIDIA cuda-samples v12.8 headers (git clone).
Target GPU: H100 (sm_90) per run2 build excerpt.

size.basis: Required inputs are 5 distinct apo PDBs (~1.0 MB total), MEGADOCK source, PINDER source archive (22.8 MB) and a shallow cuda-samples clone; outputs ~60 jobs x 50 models of a few hundred KB each (~1 GiB upper estimate not measured). Peak working set not measured; FFT grids at 1.2 A voxel for these monomers are expected well below 1 GiB, but this is an estimate, not a measurement.

scoring.native_scoring: disabled; no DockQ, no reference access
scoring.decision_rule: brief.md lines 423-427 (validity: all 48 primary jobs complete and valid with pins and prepared hashes valid)

repeatability.schedule: Serial; block 0 warmup (excluded), blocks 1-3 retained, block D diagnostic with nvidia-smi telemetry (excluded). Orders fixed in brief.md lines 399-403.
repeatability.rerun_policy: No reruns beyond the schedule; preserve every attempt.
repeatability.determinism: Fixed inputs with pinned SHA-256; fixed MEGADOCK settings -N 50 -t 1 -v 1.2 -e 1.0 -d 1.0 -a -45.0 -b 1.0 -f 3; OMP_NUM_THREADS=26.

search_note: No benchmark search performed; the benchmark is fully specified by the brief.
